storageHints.name: stat_track_u_id
storageHints.description: Anonymous visitor ID used by Personyze to recognise a returning visitor for website personalization and A/B test assignment. Set as a first-party cookie on the visited website by the Personyze tag; also mirrored in localStorage.

storageHints.name: _stat_track_s_id
storageHints.description: Personyze session ID that bounds a single browsing session. Set as a first-party cookie on the visited website; also mirrored in localStorage.

storageHints.name: stat_track_sessions
storageHints.description: Stores the start times of the visitor's recent sessions, used by Personyze for recency-based targeting. First-party cookie on the visited website; also mirrored in localStorage.

storageHints.name: stat_track_off
storageHints.description: Set only for a visitor who opts out of Personyze tracking (value off=1), so tracking stays off on later page views. First-party cookie on the visited website.

products.name: Hotjar
products.description: Imported cookie/storage reference for Hotjar. Confirm the actual product, settings and site use.

storageHints.name: _hjHasCachedUserAttributes
storageHints.description: This cookie sets when a user first lands on a page. Persists the Hotjar User ID which is unique to that site. Hotjar does not track users across different sites. Ensures data from subsequent visits to the same site are attributed to the same user ID.

storageHints.name: _hjid
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This cookie is set when the customer first lands on a page with the Hotjar script. It is used to persist the random user ID, unique to that site on the browser. This ensures that behavior in subsequent visits to the same site will be attributed to the same user ID.

storageHints.name: hj_visitor
storageHints.description: hotjar uses cookies to enhance the user’s experience on our website, for example to complete forms, navigating the site, and identify returning users and offer related content. Users can control the use of cookies at the individual browser level.

storageHints.name: _hjIncludedInSample
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This session cookie is set to let Hotjar know whether that visitor is included in the sample which is used to generate funnels.

storageHints.name: _hjClosedSurveyInvites
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This cookie is set once a visitor interacts with a Survey invitation modal popup. It is used to ensure that the same invite does not re-appear if it has already been shown.

storageHints.name: _hjDonePolls
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This cookie is set once a visitor completes a poll using the Feedback Poll widget. It is used to ensure that the same poll does not re-appear if it has already been filled in.

storageHints.name: _hjMinimizedPolls
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This cookie is set once a visitor minimizes a Feedback Poll widget. It is used to ensure that the widget stays minimizes when the visitor navigates through your site.

storageHints.name: _hjDoneTestersWidgets
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This cookie is set once a visitor submits their information in the Recruit User Testers widget. It is used to ensure that the same form does not re-appear if it has already been filled in.

storageHints.name: _hjMinimizedTestersWidgets
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie. This cookie is set once a visitor minimizes a Recruit User Testers widget. It is used to ensure that the widget stays minimizes when the visitor navigates through your site.

storageHints.name: _hjShownFeedbackMessage
storageHints.description: This cookie is set when a visitor minimizes or completes Incoming Feedback. This is done so that the Incoming Feedback will load as minimized immediately if they navigate to another page where it is set to show.

storageHints.name: _hjTLDTest
storageHints.description: When the Hotjar script executes we try to determine the most generic cookie path we should use, instead of the page hostname. This is done so that cookies can be shared across subdomains (where applicable). To determine this, we try to store the _hjTLDTest cookie for different URL substring alternatives until it fails. After this check, the cookie is removed.

storageHints.name: _hjUserAttributesHash
storageHints.description: User Attributes sent through the Hotjar Identify API are cached for the duration of the session in order to know when an attribute has changed and needs to be updated.

storageHints.name: _hjCachedUserAttributes
storageHints.description: This cookie stores User Attributes which are sent through the Hotjar Identify API, whenever the user is not in the sample. These attributes will only be saved if the user interacts with a Hotjar Feedback tool.

storageHints.name: _hjLocalStorageTest
storageHints.description: This cookie is used to check if the Hotjar Tracking Script can use local storage. If it can, a value of 1 is set in this cookie. The data stored in_hjLocalStorageTest has no expiration time, but it is deleted immediately after creating it so the expected storage time is under 100ms.

storageHints.name: _hjptid
storageHints.description: This cookie is set for logged in users of Hotjar, who have Admin Team Member permissions. It is used during pricing experiments to show the Admin consistent pricing across the site.

storageHints.name: _hjAbsoluteSessionInProgress
storageHints.description: The cookie is set so Hotjar can track the beginning of the user's journey for a total session count. It does not contain any identifiable information.

storageHints.name: _hjFirstSeen
storageHints.description: The cookie is set so Hotjar can track the beginning of the user's journey for a total session count. It does not contain any identifiable information.

storageHints.name: _hjIncludedInPageviewSample
storageHints.description: This cookie is set to let Hotjar know whether that visitor is included in the data sampling defined by your site's page view limit.

storageHints.name: _hjIncludedInSessionSample
storageHints.description: This cookie is set to let Hotjar know whether that visitor is included in the data sampling defined by your site's daily session limit

storageHints.name: _hjSession_
storageHints.description: A cookie that holds the current session data. This ensues that subsequent requests within the session window will be attributed to the same Hotjar session.

storageHints.name: _hjSessionUser_
storageHints.description: Hotjar cookie that is set when a user first lands on a page with the Hotjar script. It is used to persist the Hotjar User ID, unique to that site on the browser. This ensures that behavior in subsequent visits to the same site will be attributed to the same user ID.

storageHints.name: _hjSessionTooLarge
storageHints.description: Causes Hotjar to stop collecting data if a session becomes too large. This is determined automatically by a signal from the WebSocket server if the session size exceeds the limit.

storageHints.name: _hjSessionRejected
storageHints.description: If present, this cookie will be set to 1 for the duration of a user’s session, if Hotjar rejected the session from connecting to our WebSocket due to server overload. This cookie is only applied in extremely rare situations to prevent severe performance issues.

storageHints.name: _hjSessionResumed
storageHints.description: A cookie that is set when a session/recording is reconnected to Hotjar servers after a break in connection.

storageHints.name: hjViewportId
storageHints.description: This cookie stores user viewport details such as size and dimensions.

storageHints.name: _hjSessionStorageTest
storageHints.description: This cookie checks if the Hotjar Tracking Code can use Session Storage. If it can, a value of 1 is set.

storageHints.name: _hjCookieTest
storageHints.description: This cookie checks to see if the Hotjar Tracking Code can use cookies. If it can, a value of 1 is set.
